# ZothOS Linux v3.2 (zoth-pill) — Machine-Readable LLM Context (llms.txt)
> The Sovereign AI, Cryptographic Vault & Offensive Security Operating System
> Engineered by Neal Frazier Tech (@1nc0gn30) • NullAI Platform (https://nullai.tech)
> Canonical URL: https://zothos.nullai.tech

## Core Architecture
- **Base Distribution**: Debian 13 (Trixie) + Linux 6.12 Hybrid UEFI with surgical APT pinning for Kali Rolling & Parrot OS Security (175+ offensive security tools).
- **Desktop Environment**: KDE Plasma 6.3 Wayland with custom 24K Celtic Gold theme, interactive `org.zothos.interactive` 3D wallpaper, and `zoth-cursor-daemon` (`127.0.0.1:9989`) 60 FPS compositor cursor tracking.
- **Pre-Installed Frontier AI Agents (9)**: Google Antigravity (`agy`), Claude Code (`claude`), Grok CLI (`grok`), Aider (`aider`), Cursor AI (`cursor`), Cline (`cline`), Nous Hermes (`hermes`), OpenCode/Codex (`opencode`), and local Ollama (`ollama serve` on `127.0.0.1:11434`).
- **22 Loopback Enclave Daemons**: Bound strictly to `127.0.0.1` ports `:8094` through `:8120`, `:9393` (`zoth-civilization`), `:8787` (`zoth-vault-daemon`), and `:9989` (`zoth-cursor-daemon`).
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP) Mesh**: 5 pre-configured local MCP server clusters (`zoth-kernel-mcp`, `zoth-vault-mcp`, `zoth-hexstrike-mcp`, `zoth-memory-stdp-mcp`, `zoth-daemons-mcp`) exposed via stdio and loopback SSE.
- **Reality Pill Profiles (`zoth-mode`)**: `gold` (24K Sovereign Gold Default), `ghost` (NullAI Ghostmode + Transparent Tor + MAC Spoofing), `matrix` (Hermetic Emerald Phosphor), `incognito` (Covert Chameleon).
- **Hardware & Thermal Invariants**: `<55.0°C` CPU thermal ceiling, `0 RPM` whisper-quiet passive fan curve, `no_turbo=1` lock, and `zoth-heal` autonomous self-healing daemon.

- `/mcp` — Interactive Model Context Protocol (MCP) Config Generator, JSON-RPC 2.0 Playground & AX Hub
- `/download` — ISO Download, Sigstore Cosign Verification & Custom Live-Build ISO Recipe Generator
- `/docs` — Full System Codex, APT Pinning Architecture, Wayland SHM Pipeline, Thermal Invariants & FAQs
- `/.well-known/mcp.json` — Model Context Protocol Server & Tool Schema Manifest
- `/.well-known/agent.json` — A2A / Agent Experience (AX) Capability Card
- `/llms-full.txt` — Deep Technical Grounding Specification for Autonomous Agents
- `/ai.txt` — AI Crawler & Citation Policy Manifest
